app.name: Samavesh
footer.text: Samavesh is a final-year B.Tech project, built to WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
home.title: Support, compliance and grievance redressal in one accessible place
home.intro: Samavesh helps a higher-education institution record accommodation plans, track the support actually delivered, monitor its statutory obligations and resolve grievances.
hint.password: At least 10 characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember.
hint.code: Enter the code from the email we sent you.
hint.date_of_birth: Students only. If you are under 18 we ask a parent or guardian for consent before creating your support profile.
login.title: Sign in
login.forgot: Forgot your password, or setting one for the first time?
login.timeout: You were signed out because you were inactive for 30 minutes. Sign in again to continue.
login.passwordSet: Your password has been set. Sign in to continue.
register.title: Create an account
register.intro: Students and their parents or guardians can register here. Staff accounts are created by an administrator.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
verify.title: Check your email
verify.intro: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.resent: A new code has been sent.
verify.outbox: Development mode: open the email outbox
reset.title: Set or reset your password
reset.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a 6-digit code.
reset.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a code has been sent. It expires in 10 minutes.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: More sections will appear here as they are switched on for your role.

timeout.title: Are you still there?
timeout.body: For your security you will be signed out in about 2 minutes because you have not been active.

guardians.removed: That person no longer has access to this profile.
guardians.invite.title: Add a parent or guardian
guardians.invite.intro: They will be able to see this support profile and its accommodation plans.
hint.relationship: For example: mother, father, legal guardian.
consent.title: Consent
consent.needed: This student is under 18. A parent or guardian must consent before a support profile can be created.
consent.method.in_app: Given in Samavesh by the guardian.
consent.method.recorded_by_staff: Recorded by staff from a signed form.
consent.give.text: By giving consent you agree that the institution may record this student's support needs, including any disability information they choose to share, in order to arrange accommodations.
consent.record.title: Record consent given on paper
field.consenting_person_name: Name of the person who consented
staff.title: Assigned support staff

profile.title: Support profile
profile.none: No support profile has been created yet.
profile.blocked: A support profile cannot be created until consent has been recorded.
profile.intro: Every field is optional. Share only what helps us arrange the right support. This information is encrypted, and is visible only to the student, their guardian, assigned support staff, the nodal officer and the administrator.
field.disability_categories: Disability categories under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
field.support_needs: Support needs, in your own words
hint.support_needs: For example: a scribe in exams, course material in large print, a ground-floor classroom.
certificate.title: Disability certificate
certificate.upload.label: Choose a file to upload
certificate.upload.hint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB. Uploading replaces the current file. The file is stored encrypted.
rpwd.hearing_impairment: Hearing impairment (deaf and hard of hearing)
dashboard.overdue: Accommodations whose planned interval has passed without a logged provision.
dashboard.terms: Define the academic terms used in planned-versus-delivered reports.

plans.noProfile: A support profile must be created before a plan can be drafted.
plans.heading: Plan {id}, version {version}

plans.activeNote: A plan becomes active only when a nodal officer has approved it and its start date has arrived.

plans.form.itemsHint: Tick each accommodation the student needs and describe it. Leave the interval empty for a standing arrangement, such as a ground-floor classroom.

provision.caption: Provisions delivered: {type}

dashboard.compliance: The statutory compliance checklist, its status summary and evidence.
compliance.title: Compliance checklist
compliance.disclaimer: Source references are for tracking only and must be checked against the official text. This checklist is not legal advice.
compliance.caption: Checklist items, by due date
compliance.delete.title: Delete this item
compliance.delete.text: Deleting the item also deletes its evidence files. The deletion is recorded in the audit log.
compliance.deleted: The checklist item has been deleted.
evidence.title: Evidence files
evidence.removed: The evidence file has been removed.
evidence.upload.label: Choose an evidence file
evidence.upload.hint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB. The file is stored encrypted.
evidence.uploaded: The evidence file has been uploaded.
hint.reason: Required unless the status is Compliant.
dashboard.approvals: Accommodation plans waiting for a decision.
dashboard.audit: The permanent record of changes to profiles, plans, decisions and grievances.
approvals.title: Plans awaiting approval
approvals.none: No plans are waiting for a decision.
approvals.heading: Plan {id}, version {version}: {name}
approvals.readOnly: Only a nodal officer can approve or reject a plan.
approvals.replaces: This version replaces plan {id}, which stays active until this one is approved.
hint.decisionReason: Required when rejecting. The reason is recorded and shown with the plan.
plans.rejected: The plan has been rejected and returned to the support staff.
decisions.title: Decision history for plan {id}
plans.revise: Create a new version of plan {id}
audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: A permanent record of every create, update and delete. Entries cannot be edited or deleted by anyone, including administrators. Values of encrypted fields are never recorded.
audit.caption: Audit entries, newest first
dashboard.grievances: Grievances received, with the complainant's identity where they gave it.
dashboard.escalation: The working-day limit for escalation, working weekdays and holidays.
dashboard.escalated: Escalated or overdue grievances, shown without complainant identity.
grievance.new.title: Raise a grievance
grievance.new.intro: You do not need an account. You will get a tracking reference to check progress later.
grievance.new.identity: How should we record who you are?
grievance.new.anonymous: Anonymous: record nothing that identifies me
grievance.new.identityHint: Anonymous means no name, no account link and no IP address is kept. The tracking reference is then the only way to follow the case. Only the grievance officer can ever see a name.
field.subject: Subject
hint.contact_email: Optional. Used only to tell you when the status changes; only the grievance officer can see it. Leave empty if anonymous.
grievance.submitted.title: Grievance received
grievance.submitted.text: Thank you. Your grievance has been recorded.
grievance.submitted.keep: Write this reference down now. It cannot be recovered, and it is the only way to check the status without signing in.
track.title: Track a grievance
track.intro: Enter your tracking reference to see the status. No sign-in is needed.
error.reference_not_found: No grievance matches that reference. Check it and try again.
error.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.name_required: Enter your name, or choose to stay anonymous.
error.invalid_transition: That status change is not allowed from the current status.
error.holiday_exists: That date is already a holiday.
grievance.inbox.title: Grievances
grievance.inbox.caption: All grievances, newest first
grievance.case.title: Grievance
hint.publicNote: Shown to the complainant on the tracking page.
hint.internalNote: Visible only to the grievance officer.
grievance.escalated.title: Escalated grievances
grievance.escalated.intro: Cases escalated by the grievance officer or flagged automatically. The complainant's identity is never shown here.
escalation.title: Escalation settings
escalation.intro: A grievance under review for more than this many working days is flagged for escalation.
notifications.title: Notifications
notice.plan_rejected: A plan has been rejected. Open it to see the reason.
notice.plan_review: An accommodation plan is due for review within 7 days.
notice.compliance_due: A compliance item is due within {days} days.
notice.escalation: Grievance {reference} has been flagged for escalation.
error.plan_not_submitted: This plan is not waiting for a decision.
error.plan_not_approved: Only an approved plan can be changed this way.
error.revision_exists: A new version of this plan is already being prepared.
error.rule.review_date: Must be later than the start date
error.rule.end_date: Must be later than the start date
error.interval: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 365, or leave it empty
error.plan_not_editable: This plan can no longer be edited. Approved plans are changed by creating a new version.
error.plan_not_draft: Only a draft plan can be submitted.
error.plan_not_active: Provisions can only be logged against an approved plan that has started.
error.provision_date_invalid: The date must be between the plan's start date and today.
error.profile_has_plans: This profile has accommodation plans and cannot be deleted.
error.range: Enter a number within the allowed range
error.already_linked: That person is already linked to this student.

error.consent_not_needed: This student is 18 or over, so no consent record is needed.

error.date_in_future: The date cannot be in the future.

error.already_assigned: That staff member is already assigned to this student.
error.profile_required: Create the support profile before uploading a certificate.
